$doc: Host and path rules for HTTP Request nodes whose method alone does not settle the effect. Read by scripts/analyze.mjs.

The URL is read only when its scheme and host are literal; {{ }} parts of the path stand in as {x}. host is matched exactly (no subdomains), path is a regular expression tested against the path without query string.

model: a POST to a known LLM API. The node becomes kind model, effect none, lever llm-api, and adds the httpSubstitutions.model requirement from capabilities.json: the call can run on the subscription instead of an API key.
write: an endpoint that always writes, so no question is asked. host is optional.

read: an endpoint that reads although it takes a POST. host is optional. graphql: true means the body decides: a mutation is a write, a literal query without mutation a read, anything else stays undetermined.
When the base URL comes from an expression ({{ }}/path), only rules without host can match.
Rules are general (provider APIs and URL shapes), never one template's URL.

write.why: an OAuth token endpoint issues new tokens (a refresh can retire the old one)
a bot API method that sends or changes messages (Telegram style)
a WhatsApp Cloud API message send

read.why: a search, query or list endpoint
a GraphQL query without a mutation
